coverage_rule: All 24 retained MHTs receive an MSS supernatural-foundation relevance decision; prior route tags are evidence but are not an exhaustive filter.

authority.taxonomy: MSS-01 separates source artifact, tradition/source family, effect/subtype family, runtime concept and canonical owner domain
authority.resolution: MSS-03 owns unified spell/power/supernatural resolution with Action/Event and external owner seams
authority.runes: MSS-04 owns Rune Construction/blind GM adjudication; recovered glyph/rune language does not automatically enter Rune Construction
authority.authoring: MSS-05 remains completed_verified; recovered material may be source/proposal reference only
authority.world_timeline: MIB-11/D18-A10 owns worlds, portal destinations, timelines, eras and branches
authority.rule: RSR-07 preserves, classifies and routes evidence without creating canonical formulas, stable IDs, abilities, resources, portals, timeline mutations, spell effects or external-owner state.

records.owner_evidence: Warforms cost more and are more straining.
records.reconciliation_note: Visible content is Kola-Ha Formcraft/Warforms. Psychic/radiant/necrotic/ritual language remains assistant proposal; biotech stays CCP/DPL and shared strain/resonance vocabulary does not create MSS authority.
Soul fragments, pacts, curses, fate binding and portal-market mechanics are assistant-generated Black Vegas proposals, not universal MSS rules.

records.owner_evidence: Owner uses the exact descriptive phrase 'Furashin mage'.
records.reconciliation_note: This supports role/name context only; it establishes no Furashin tradition, spell list, casting profile, resource or supernatural stable ID.
Divine resonance, ritual cleansing, vision glimpses, Ritual Lore and Arcana are assistant proposals only.
Goblin magical artifacts, alchemy/potions and portal-connected settlements are assistant setting/species proposals, not exact MSS mechanics.

Raven Stones, psychic beacons/backlash, Dissonance, gate collapse, time-sealing, soul-echo and reality-editing material is assistant proposal; owner Serpent telepathy comes from the separate Consortium source.

Blood mysticism, curses, necrotic/radiant interactions, spell echoes, spirits/undead, soul-bound technology, reincarnation and ritual warfare remain setting-scoped assistant proposals; ICF retains biological harvest.
Spirit Communion, omens, celestial signs, rituals, Shadow Leap and Spirit Whisperer material remains assistant culture/profession proposal.

Ritual/Psychic tags, psionic resonance, radiant/psychic/force damage, spell absorption and undead barriers are assistant mechanics within Kola-Ha biotech proposals; CCP/DPL remain owners unless later supernatural adoption is explicit.
Magic Level, structured arcana, unstable resonance, casual gods, telepathic/ritual contact, dreamcasting, chaos cults, wild magic and portal claims are assistant setting proposals.

records.owner_evidence: Owner evidence supports prosperity/subsidization, not supernatural mechanics.
records.reconciliation_note: Outlaw magitech, forbidden portals, soul-fracture, arcane signatures and temporal duplication are assistant proposals only.
Glyphs, Under-Sigils, lullabies, repair hymns, ghost markets, dream-responsive blooms and semi-sacred mites remain assistant ritual/supernatural proposals.

records.owner_evidence: Owner establishes a reality-wide non-Euclidean Carnival outside the Empire.
records.reconciliation_note: Trickster-god, narrative-magic, god-fragment, sorcerer/dreamwalker and spacetime-wound explanations are assistant alternatives; none is selected as the Carnival's supernatural ontology.

records.owner_evidence: Owner requires faction perks that can include trans-portal assistance such as bombing strikes and healing payloads.
records.reconciliation_note: Specific soul anchors, demonic pacts, branded rituals, corruption, infernal portals/allies, soul severing and numeric effects remain assistant proposals.

records.owner_evidence: Serpents communicate telepathically through negative emotions; humanity is disconnected from innate spiritual/psychic powers; Consortium species abilities were interpreted as gods/myth in the Age of the Gods.
records.reconciliation_note: Preserve those owner facts as source evidence without inferring a telepathy formula, universal psychic resource, deity/patron system or exact supernatural powers.
Dark-magic resistance, corruption detection, possession/scrying resistance, portal/rift sensing and fear/charm/illusion defenses are assistant Character/profession proposals.

records.owner_evidence: Owner establishes natural portals between eras at Pentavos and the early-iteration/dual-awareness chronology.
records.reconciliation_note: Preserve the portal/temporal facts exactly; assistant chronal resonance and lunar stabilization remain proposals and MIB-11 stays World/Timeline authority.

records.owner_evidence: Owner establishes Age-of-Orilaun travel through official and hidden 30 Winds portals and an explicit hidden-history boundary.
records.reconciliation_note: Preserve travel/visibility facts; assistant energy streams, techno-magical origins and portal hazards remain proposals or hidden history, and in-era views may not expose later New Tokyo/Dominix or lost Consortium-origin context.
Visible material is geography, agriculture, alchemy/production and world design; incidental spiritual-observation wording does not establish supernatural mechanics.

records.owner_evidence: Owner defines the Ocularum as seeing into other realities and piloting Antiquaria from inside God's Eye.
records.reconciliation_note: Preserve the cross-reality function while leaving its mechanism unresolved; do not classify it as magic, portal, divine or technology without evidence. Assistant priest/mystic/prophecy roles remain proposals.

records.owner_evidence: Owner correction keeps Sapphire absent in the current pre-New-Tokyo timeline.
records.reconciliation_note: Assistant byway material includes magical influence and differing environmental/magical laws; preserve as spatial/worldbuilding proposal while MIB-11 owns topology. Do not force all byways into MSS portal mechanics.

records.owner_evidence: Owner requires multiple mana types including normal mana, each with source, value relative to regular mana, unique effects and rarity.
records.reconciliation_note: Preserve the design requirement. Assistant Aether/Nebula/Crystal/Flora/Stellar/Tidal/Tempest names, multipliers, effects, rarities and leyline claims remain proposals; no universal conversion/value formula is inferred.

records.owner_evidence: Owner requested design exploration rather than selecting a supernatural model.
records.reconciliation_note: Generic magic, ritual, psychic-development and portal examples occur only inside assistant-generated social models and are not setting-specific supernatural evidence.

records.owner_evidence: Owner establishes the overtly gamified leaping-realm premise; detailed supernatural mechanics are assistant proposals.
records.reconciliation_note: Local spells, gods/fate quest authority, soul qualities, reincarnation/respawn and magic-dependent processes remain proposals; WCI/SGC/DPL own the broader reality-kernel/progression interface.
